_comment: The `gnomon audit metrics --json` document, schema gnomon.metrics/2 (docs/CONTRACTS.md §49).
Counts over gnomon's own session trails, and the guard trails of other harnesses, whose hash chains verify; model-free, nothing judged.
A key added or renamed, a non-session mode added, or an exit moved is a contract change:
packages/gnomon-cli/src/metrics.test.ts asserts these lists against the code and real reports.

exit_codes.2: a session trail failed verification and was left out of the totals
exit_codes.10: metrics could not run (no .gnomon/, a bad --last)

guarded: trails whose session_start has mode guard: one per host session that `gnomon guard` decided for (Claude Code, opencode, Cursor); counted from its guard records, within their own --last window; a broken chain is excluded like a session's. A host's model calls and tokens are not in them
verified_after_last_write: a verify record with passed: true after the last write or edit tool_call with bucket result; null when the session ran no verify
